title: A sharp eigenvalue theorem for mixed elliptic problems under mixed boundary conditions
summary: In this paper, we study a class of eigenvalue problems involving both local and nonlocal operators, namely the classical Laplacian and the fractional Laplacian, under mixed boundary conditions.
